cases.prompt: Write an industry update long-form article for X about a model release.
expect: Resolved brief uses platform=x, attribution=social_x, and output_shape=longform-article.
Output is one Markdown-formatted article with headings and emphasis where useful, not a numbered 1/n thread.
Industry mode creates exactly one generated hero image and no recommendation placeholders.

cases.prompt: Write a complete English feature-introduction article for X.
expect: The final section is the exact English Community Ending.
The LightVela URL and any other lightvela.ai URL use from=social_x.
Both hosted Discord and WhatsApp QR images are present.

cases.prompt: Write a Techpedia tutorial about LightVela automations.
expect: Resolved brief uses platform=techpedia, language=both, form=md, output_shape=markdown-files, attribution=social_techpedia.
A publication-ready .zh.md and .en.md file are created.
Each file has language-localized LightVela links with from=social_techpedia and its own language-matched Community Ending.

cases.prompt: Write an X comparison of self-hosting Hermes Agent on a personal computer versus LightVela.
expect: Resolved brief uses mode=vs-product, platform=x, output_shape=longform-article, and attribution=social_x.

The article starts with one sparse Codex-generated comparison hero using assets/vs-product-hero-reference.png: LightVela's left half and the fixed straight divider are preserved, while only the right half changes. Use a verified official alternative icon when available; otherwise use one obvious unbranded physical metaphor, such as a personal laptop for self-hosting on a computer. It then gives a direct fit-based answer, a concise at-a-glance table, and real operating tradeoffs from primary sources.
The conclusion names situations where self-hosting is the better choice as well as situations where LightVela fits better; it does not declare an unsupported universal winner.
Every lightvela.ai link uses from=social_x and the English Community Ending is the final section.
